text:
alex: Heads-up — embeddings service returning 503s for some requests since ~10:20 PST. We've got a prepared hotfix (PR #4321) that fixes a race in connection pool. Need expedited approval to pin and push a late-window hotpatch. Details below.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline passed: https://ci.redwood/4321 build 9876
deploy-bot: Candidate image: gcr.io/redwood/embeddings:pr-4321-20260318

maria: how widespread? any customer-facing errors / SLO hits?

alex: ~2% of requests, spike on eu-west1 edge, started 10:20. Alert: embeddings-5xx-rate > 0.5% for last 10m. Impacting realtime feature refresh for 3 accounts.

jamal: can we canary 5% then observe 15m? what's rollback plan?

alex: yes. rollback = revert to image gcr.io/redwood/embeddings:prod-20260315, run cache-warm and drain kvcache. Steps:
```
kubectl set image deploy/embeddings embeddings=gcr.io/redwood/embeddings:pr-4321-20260318 --record
# if rollback
kubectl set image deploy/embeddings embeddings=gcr.io/redwood/embeddings:prod-20260315
```

sarah-oncall: oncall +1. If 5xx > 0.5% for 3 consecutive 1m buckets within 15m, we rollback. Also monitor latency and kvcache hit-rate.

release-manager: +1 from release. Need release notes line and changelog entry before +merge.

product-ops: add short release note: "Fix: embeddings 503 under high connection churn (hotfix)". I'll post to status page if rollout goes green :white_check_mark:

alex: noted. I'll open changelog entry and mention customers. Requesting expedited pin for dedicated pools too (EU pools) — possible?

jamal: ops, can we pin EU dedicated pool to the new image for canary at 5%? We have capacity.

opsbot: EU dedicated pool scheduled for canary pin to pr-4321 at 10:35 UTC pending approval.

release-manager: consensus: proceed. rolling canary to 5% now, monitor 15m, then 25% if healthy. All hands ready for rollback.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: 5% -> 10 pods. Tracking: https://ci.redwood/deploys/9876

alex: thanks everyone — I'll post final status in 15m. :thumbsup:
